title: Beginner Interview Questions
definition: Common Git questions asked during entry-level developer interviews to ensure the candidate understands basic version control concepts.
simpleExplanation: Interviewers want to make sure you know how to save code, push it to GitHub, and understand the difference between Git and GitHub.
realWorldExample: Being asked 'What is the difference between `git fetch` and `git pull`?'

basic: What is the command to initialize a new Git repository?

answers.question: What is the Staging Area?
answers.answer: It is an intermediate area (the 'Index') where you can gather specific modified files to be included in the next commit, without having to commit every single changed file in your project.
